learning_objective: 🎯 Journey through the vibrant folk music of India and see how everyday people celebrate life, nature, and festivals through joyful songs!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Folk music is the simple, heartfelt music created by everyday people in villages and towns. It is not learned in big schools but is proudly passed down from grandparents to children over hundreds of years!
In India, there is a special folk song for almost everything! People sing joyfully when planting seeds in the fields, when welcoming the rainy monsoon, or during bright, colorful harvest festivals.
Folk music is all about community and friendship. Everyone joins in to sing, clap, and dance in big circles, making everyone feel happy, connected, and part of one big joyful family.

fun_activity.title: 🎤 Ask the Elders
fun_activity.instructions: Ask your grandparents, parents, or an older neighbor to teach you a traditional folk song from their hometown, and try singing the chorus together with a big smile!

quick_recap: ⭐ Folk music belongs to the everyday people and connects us deeply to our land, seasons, and local festivals.
⭐ It is a joyful, highly energetic way to bring communities together to sing, dance, and celebrate life.
